name: Open-source Galician children's fable about open source

mentions.name: Open-source Galician children's fable about open source
mentions.description: An open-source children's fable written in Galician that introduces open source through storytelling, with community translations into Spanish and English underway; the author is seeking funding for printing and distribution of the book.
mentions.source_excerpt: I wrote a children’s story in Galician about open source. It's told as a fable. I made it open source, and people are now helping translate it into Spanish and English.
